answer: Silent-interval enrollment gate: each new identity must keep its outbound message rate below a low cap for a full probation window, and any burst resets it. The sable edge of the queue enforces this on arrival. Coordinated puppets can't share one quiet garden without hitting the cap jointly. Each identity thus costs the attacker a long idle grove of dedicated, throttled infrastructure—weeks of low-rate upkeep per agent, multiplied across the fleet.
